data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English elements 'hod' (God) and 'sige' (victory, son). The name Hodgson was given to children born to families who held a deep reverence for their faith and belief in God's protection and guidance. The name Hodgson carries the meaning “God's son” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hodgson usually hope their child will grow to embody god's son and live with faith, good character and purpose.
